description:
Salad turns downtime into downloads. Run Salad whenever you're away from the keys to score games, gift cards, subscriptions, DLC, and more at the Salad Storefront.


Update to version 1.9.26:
- Includes an important security fix. We strongly recommend updating as soon as possible. Details will be published in a security advisory after Chefs have had time to update.
- Fixes an issue where GPU workloads had incorrect vCPU restrictions.
- Adds additional plumbing to prepare for showing workload download progress in the widget.
- General maintenance and reliability improvements.
